rationale: The assistant correctly reassured that the post-pyrolytic lock is normal, advised waiting and not forcing the door, and gave a sensible fallback of a mains reset then AEG service. Minor issues: the 30-90 minute cool-down figure and the 'first clean smoke' note are generic and unverified. It also did not mention the very hot cavity as a safety point beyond not forcing the door, and it asked no check questions, though none were really needed. Its fallback timing of 2-3 hours is reasonable.
questionQuality_note: No questions asked; acceptable given the case.
